Class CardState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.state.CardState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
BuildingCardState, CharacterCardState, EventCardState
public abstract class CardState extends Object implements Serializable
Common base class for the serializable, immutable snapshots of any card exposed by the model to its clients.
